hypothesis.claim: A long-lived ComponentPresetCatalog must reload the shared persistence file before page/detail reads; otherwise correct mutations in another instance remain invisible or deleted definitions remain visible.
hypothesis.trigger: two catalogs or HTTP servers are constructed before one of them mutates a shared presets.json
hypothesis.expected_baseline: cross-instance detail/page reads use stale construction-time state
hypothesis.expected_candidate: cross-instance reads see creates and updates, and see 404/KeyError after deletion; corrupt persisted data fails explicitly
hypothesis.falsifier: a valid shared-directory mutation remains invisible after the reader call, a deleted definition is returned, or invalid persistence is silently presented as a valid read

implementation: reload presets.json at the start of ComponentPresetCatalog.page
reload presets.json at the start of ComponentPresetCatalog.detail
retain last valid in-memory state when a mutation reload fails, while read reload errors remain visible
activation_checks: baseline stale detail/page reproduction failed before the change
independent HTTP servers observed create=201, update=200, delete=200 and the second server read 200/200/404
invalid persisted JSON is surfaced instead of returned as a successful stale read
update/delete concurrency artifact found no non-linearizable race
